name: Password Strength Enforcement
description: Enforces strong password policies for all Jellyfin users. Admins can trigger a mandatory password reset that logs out all non-admin users and requires them to set a new password meeting minimum strength requirements on next login.
overview: Enforces strong passwords (min 8 chars, uppercase, lowercase, number). Includes an admin panel to force password resets with re-authentication confirmation.

versions.changelog: Initial release — force reset button, strength validation, post-login enforcement overlay.
